newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products stable, arb interest helps naphth.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products stable, arb interest helps naphth.

text.p: NWE oil products ended steady on Tuesday, traders said.
Gasoline prices were stable. NYMEX unleaded futures had offered little fresh direction and demand in NWE was relaxed.
Naphtha prices were steady at the lower levels. Far East buying interest and scarce offers of product boosted sentiment.
Gas oil outright prices firmed $1 a tonne in line with the IPE May screen. Heating oil and diesel premiums were steady.
High sulphur barges picked up. Cargoes were quiet, though Scandinavian one percent material was being discussed.
